name: wireflow
description: Clickable wireflow review: connected mock screens, scenario checks for journeys and recovery paths, and copyable change requests.

interface.shortDescription: Review app structure and user flow as clickable connected mock screens.
interface.longDescription: Wireflow turns a brief, screenshots, routes, or a feature-intake analysis into an editable flow JSON and a single self-contained HTML viewer. Screens are grouped by task and connected by arrows; scenarios replay main journeys and recovery paths (cancel, back, retry) and flag dead ends and missing links. Fix proposals can be previewed without touching the baseline, and reviewers copy precise per-screen change requests back to the agent.
